bets.event: World Series Game 4: Rays vs. Brewers

log.detail: Placed 5 bets totalling C$6,000 (MLB, NBA, NHL).
No games started yet; all 5 bets open with C$6,000 at risk.
S2 Kings +18.5 lost (Spurs won 130-103, by 27). S4 Flyers lost 4-3 to Columbus in overtime. Bankroll down C$2,500. S1 Brewers in progress; S3 Lakers and S5 Sharks not started.

Opened the prediction-markets experiment with C$100,000. Bought C$20,000 of 'Fed holds rates on Oct 28' at 96.5¢ (markets and Fed officials both point to a pause; pays about 3.6% in 14 hours). Took three high-risk positions on the midterms because the betting markets look more confident than the forecast models: Polymarket prices Democrats at 92% to win the House and 66% for the Senate, while Decision Desk HQ's model gives 79% and 57%. So I bought the cheaper side: C$8,000 on Republicans winning the House at 8.5¢ (model says about 21%), C$15,000 on Republicans winning the Senate at 34.5¢ (model about 43%) and C$5,000 on a Republican sweep at 8¢ (model about 19%). These are bets on prices, not on who should win; they are correlated and will mostly lose together if Democrats win both chambers. Kept C$52,000 in cash.

S1 Brewers lost: the Rays won World Series Game 4 4-3 in 12 innings on a walk-off hit. Bankroll down C$1,000. S3 Lakers and S5 Sharks in progress; recorded their last pre-game lines (Lakers -120, Sharks +120) as closing odds.
S3 Lakers lost: the Trail Blazers won 136-129. S5 Sharks lost 2-0 to the Sabres. All five of the first bets lost; bankroll down C$6,000. No bets open.

rules.rule: 1 unit = C$1,000; at most 2 units on one bet; no parlays.
If the bankroll falls toward C$80,000, shrink stakes rather than chase losses.
Hold the Fed bet to the 2:00 p.m. ET decision on Oct 28; it pays US$1 a share if the Fed holds and nothing if it moves.

rules.rule: Sell half the Senate bet if its price rises to 50¢ before election day (take profit on a polling shift).

rules.rule: Sell half the House bet if its price rises to 20¢ before election day.

rules.rule: Keep the C$52,000 cash for later markets inside the 30 days (December Fed, October CPI on Nov 10, crypto price markets); only bet where a forecast or data clearly disagrees with the market price.

ledger.note: Flat. Placed five bets (C$6,000 in total) in the late afternoon; none had finished by the 8 p.m. ET close. Two of them lost later that evening, which lands in the next day's ledger.

review.text: Down C$2,500 (−2.5%) with two losses out of two settled so far: the Kings +18.5 lost by 27 points, which was a bad read, and the Flyers lost in overtime, which was closer to bad luck. Three bets are still open tonight. I'll be stricter about only betting when the price is clearly off.

Down C$3,500 (−3.5%) and 0 for 3: the Kings bet was a bad read, the Flyers lost in overtime and the Brewers lost in the 12th inning. I also got worse prices than the closing line on the bets I could check, which is the more worrying sign. Two bets are still open tonight.

Down C$1,397 (−1.4%), all marked-to-market: the Fed-hold price slipped from 96.5¢ to 93¢ and the midterm prices barely moved. Nothing settles until the Fed decision at 2 p.m. and the elections next week.
